directions.name: The unopened box
directions.central_object: a sealed cardboard box on a desk
arc: a hand reaches for it but hesitates
the box finally opens, light spilling out
directions.rejects: a direction that shows the contents up front

directions.name: The widening crack
directions.central_object: a hairline crack in a ceramic mug
arc: the crack is a single thin line
steam finds the crack and escapes
the mug splits cleanly along the line
directions.rejects: a direction where the mug never actually breaks
